mapper.select: SELECT SZF_GETDOCNUMBER(#{DOCUTY}) AS DOCSEQ FROM DUAL
SELECT SZF_SEQDOCNUMBER(#{NUMOBJ}) AS NUMSEQ FROM DUAL
SELECT WAREKY AS VALUE_COL, NAME01 AS TEXT_COL FROM WAHMA WHERE DELMAK = ' ' ORDER BY WAREKY
SELECT WAREKY AS VALUE_COL , NAME01 AS TEXT_COL FROM WAHMA WHERE WAREKY IN ( SELECT WAREKY FROM ROLCT WHERE UROLKY IN ( SELECT UROLKY FROM USRRA WHERE USERID = #{SES_USER_ID} ) ) ORDER BY WAREKY
SELECT WAREKY AS VALUE_COL, NAME02 AS TEXT_COL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'LANGKY' ORDER BY CMCDVL DESC
SELECT DEPART , USERG1 AS AREA , USERG2 AS ZONE , USERG3 AS LOCA , USERG4 AS LOCA1 , USERG5 AS ETC FROM USRMA WHERE USERID = #{SES_USER_ID}
SELECT COUNT(LM.LOCAKY) OVER() AS CNT , LM.LOCAKY , LM.MIXSKU , LM.MIXLOT FROM LOCMA LM WHERE 1=1 AND LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.LOCAKY = #{LOCAKY}
